sections.name: File setup, GET
sections.title: Single document lookup handler
sections.what: Returns one document for a case with its prepared version, or a not-found response when the pair does not match.
sections.why: Likely reason: keeps document lookup tied to its case.
sections.watch_out: Keep both the case id and document id in the lookup, or documents from other cases could be exposed.

summary: Web address that returns one synthetic document for a case, along with its prepared version.
purpose: Lets the app show the details of a single document.
why: Likely reason: the document view needs one item at a time.
how: Reads the case id and document id, makes sure seed documents exist, and looks up the document for that case. It returns the document and its prepared version, or a not-found response.
inputs: Case id and document id in the address.
outputs: JSON with a data field holding the document and preparedDocument, or a not-found response.
risks: The source line is cut off, so the exact not-found response is inferred from sibling routes. Lookup uses both ids together, which protects against cross-case reads.
debug: If a document cannot be found, confirm the seed documents were loaded and that the case id matches the document's case.
